opening.argument: The presenter promotes MTI as a way to build Bitcoin rapidly, beginning with the instruction that “you need to start with $100 balance of bitcoin” and presenting AI software as something from which viewers benefit. He connects that funding path to the promise that “you are going to get paid every day,” while also describing profit sharing through a two-sided structure and referral-based bonuses. The presentation includes unusually large growth and daily-profit figures, account-registration instructions, and directions associated with transferring Bitcoin into a trading pool. Although it includes a disclaimer and says recruitment is not required, the material still frames participation as a route to automatic compounding and daily returns. It does not establish that any payment or payout actually occurred.
